_doc: CCR WORLD - Inventory item manifest. Create one DA_Item_<ItemId> UCCRInventoryItemDefinition in Content/CCR/Items/ for each entry.
_howto: Add one entry per collectible item. Set ItemId to match the FName passed to UCCRInventorySubsystem::AddItem(). Icon path: /Game/CCR/Textures/Items/T_Item_<ItemId>.
